main_measure.name: mean short-direction unusual 5-bar move (minus (5-bar return - coin's normal 5-bar drift))

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of the same day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, top half minus bottom half at median |forecast|

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2 and the top |forecast| half at least the bottom half: confirm rule.
reading: Situation bars are those the engine labelled mean_reversion, with the close-location, 5-day-return and 60-day-return conditions re-checked from prices where the window's bars allow (the 365-day swing percentile cannot be rebuilt inside a window, so the regime label stands for it); a case is the first short bet in each 5-bar grid cell of a window with its 5-bar return from that bet's close; the top half of the split is |forecast| strictly above the median; the plan's 'fewer than 30 cases' rule is applied as 'not observable' per the workflow.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01096 on the check folds against +0.02477 on every fold
